text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chaired a cabinet meeting on policy in the social sector during the next five years.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui back to Tunis after a three-day visit to Spain where he held talks with Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar.
- Parliament takes a second look at the local taxation code draft.
- Tunisia's policy in the social sector during the next five years to be focused on aid for the poorest and expanding the social security coverage.
- Parliament ratified financial accords with Germany and Japan.
